subject: Discovery recap: observability & evals — ZenHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenhealth.com>, Maya Turner <maya.turner@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Discovery recap: observability & evals — ZenHealth

Hi Samir / Maya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and to make next steps explicit. Please reply with any corrections.

Top pain points you shared:
- Lack of visibility into model regressions after nightly deployments (false positives in triage, long debug cycle)
- Cost unpredictability across prompt variations and production vs. eval workloads
- No centralized tracing from app request -> model tokens (hard to tie user issue to prompt/regeneration)

Current stack:
- In-house web app + Node backend behind GCP load balancer
- Embeddings and LLMs are currently on a mix of managed endpoints (vendor X) and a small in-house GPU pool for experimental models
- Datadog for infra metrics; no dedicated model-level dashboards yet

Success criteria for the eval (what you told us):
1) Detect regressions within 24h of a release with actionable alerting (golden prompt regression sets + delta metrics)
2) End-to-end tracing that ties a customer request to the exact prompt + model version + token usage
3) Cost target: keep inference spend within $X/month for the MVP (we’ll refine once we see batch/seq stats)
4) Ability to rollout with guardrails (canary, auto-fallback to a cheaper variant on SLA breach)

Requested deliverables we discussed:
- Demo dashboards: 1) Regression overview, 2) Golden prompts performance, 3) Cost-by-route per model
- Tracing hooks: small instrumentation for request IDs -> model call metadata (we can provide a lightweight middleware)
- Golden prompt set: you’ll share ~50-100 canonical prompts and success criteria for each (we’ll convert to eval suites)
- Regression alerting + rollout guardrails: thresholded alerts and automatic fallback rules

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share an eval plan (attached) with kickoff agenda and timelines for a 4-week MVP.
2) Rishi will scope tracing integration and provide sample middleware for your Node stack.
3) Neha will prepare a cost/SLAs note and sample rollout policy.
4) You (Samir/Maya) to share the golden prompt set and the security questionnaire (if you want us to pre-fill any fields).

Attachments: ZenHealth_MVP_eval_plan.xlsx (plan & timeline), Redwood_SOW_draft.pdf (draft SOW for enterprise eval).

Proposed kickoff: Thu Jul 23 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri Jul 24 09:00–10:00 PT — which works for you?

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Maya Turner <maya.turner@zenhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: observability & evals — ZenHealth

Thanks Marissa — this looks right to me. A couple notes / clarifications:
- Timeline: we’re aiming to have a vendor-ready eval report by mid-August so we can include findings in our Q3 planning. A 4-week MVP is tight but reasonable.
- Security: I attached our security questionnaire (ZenHealth_security_questionnaire_v1.docx) — can you have your security team answer the SOC2 / data residency bits we flagged? If you can pre-fill answers for the standard items that helps speed procurement.
- Dashboards: the three dashboards you listed are exactly what we need — particularly the per-route cost breakdown. Will you provide dashboard templates (Grafana / Datadog) or are these Redwood Console screenshots?

One ask from Eng: can you instrument tracing to carry our internal request_id and return it in the model-level traces so we can correlate in our logs? If Rishi can share the middleware we’ll schedule a short integration spike.

I’m good to kick off Thu Jul 23 10:00 PT.

Samir
Director of Product | ZenHealth
samir.gupta@zenhealth.com | +1 (628) 555-0199

Attachment: ZenHealth_security_questionnaire_v1.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwoodai.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenhealth.com>, Maya Turner <maya.turner@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodai.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: observability & evals — ZenHealth

Great — locking in Thu Jul 23 10:00 PT for kickoff. Agenda & invites to follow.

Quick answers to the items above and owners:
- Dashboards: we’ll provision Redwood Console dashboards for the eval (exportable) and provide sample Datadog/Grafana JSONs you can import. Rishi — I’ll need the preferred Datadog space from Samir.
- Tracing: yes — we’ll instrument to accept and propagate your request_id. Rishi will share the Node middleware and a small example for how the trace ties request -> prompt -> model_version + token usage.
- Security questionnaire: I’ve looped in our security team; we’ll pre-fill the standard SOC2 and encryption answers and flag anything that requires legal review. Expect a response in 48–72h.
- Golden prompts: Samir — once you send the set we’ll convert into an eval suite and define pass/fail criteria per prompt. If helpful we can run a short baseline run and share pre/post metrics.

Action items (owners):
- Samir / Maya: Share golden prompts (50–100), preferred Datadog space, any redlines on the SOW (by Tue Jul 21 EOD).
- Rishi (redwood): Share Node middleware + tracing example (by Wed Jul 22).
- Neha (redwood): Draft rollout guardrails and cost projections for MVP (by Wed Jul 22).
- Marissa: Send calendar invite + kickoff agenda (done).

Attachments: I re-attached the MVP plan and SOW draft for your review.

Looking forward — we’ll have a short pre-kickoff sync internally tomorrow afternoon to ensure Rishi/Neha have what they need.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Discovery recap: observability & evals — ZenHealth

Quick internal note — I’ll have a prototype Node middleware and a Datadog dashboard JSON by EOD Wed Jul 22. The middleware will:
- accept incoming request_id header (X-Request-ID), attach to model call metadata, and emit trace spans including prompt hash, model_version, and token counts
- include an opt-in sampling policy for full text traces to protect PII (we’ll default to hashed prompts + token-level metrics)

I’ll also prepare a checklist for rollout guardrails (canary window, SLA thresholds, automatic fallback rules) for Neha to include in the cost/projection doc.

Rishi
Staff ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
